user.title: ZKSJ wave pump
user.description: These are the Tuya devices broadcasting on your network. Pick your pump; you will only need to paste its local key.

key.title: Local key
key.description:
Found the pump at {host} (device id {device_id}).

Paste its local key for full control. **Leave it blank** to add the pump in monitor-only mode: you get a Connection sensor showing whether it has power and is on the network, and nothing else — reading its mode, speed or on/off state is not possible without the key. You can add the key later with Reconfigure.

manual.title: Enter the pump by hand
manual.description: No pump was found broadcasting, or you chose to type it in. Find the address with `python -m tinytuya scan`. Leave the local key blank for monitor-only mode.

reconfigure.title: Update pump connection
reconfigure.description: Point Home Assistant at a new address, add a local key to a monitor-only pump, or replace a key that changed after re-pairing. Clearing the key returns the pump to monitor-only.

error.cannot_connect: No reply from the pump on any Tuya protocol version. Check the local key first — a wrong key looks exactly like this. Also make sure nothing else is holding the pump's local connection open.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while contacting the pump.

abort.already_configured: This pump is already set up.

feed.name: Feed mode
feed.description: Slows the pump for feeding. The pump runs the countdown itself and returns to its program.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long feed mode lasts, in seconds.

power.name: Flow
power.description: Flow to hold during feed mode, as a percentage.

set_program.name: Set program
set_program.description: Replaces the pump's whole daily program with a list of segments.

segments.name: Segments
segments.description: Segments, each with a wave type, a start and end time, and its flow, frequency and duty cycle.

sync_time.name: Sync clock
sync_time.description: Pushes Home Assistant's local time to the pump, so time-based programs run at the right hour.
